title: 拉格朗德複合水電系統
summary: 拉格朗德複合系統把鄰近三條河的水引入拉格朗德河，沿約 800 km 的河段建了十餘座電站，總容量超過 16,000 MW；課程定量分析引水使流量倍增的效益、梯級水頭的重複利用、冬季冰蓋下的水力條件，以及送往美國新英格蘭的多端直流輸電。
summaryEn: The La Grande complex diverts three neighbouring rivers into the La Grande and has more than ten stations along about 800 km of river totalling over 16,000 MW; the course quantifies the benefit of doubling flow by diversion, repeated use of head down the cascade, hydraulics under winter ice cover, and multi-terminal HVDC export to New England.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 跨流域引水、多年調節梯級與寒帶冬季尖峰運轉
v30FocusEn: Inter-basin diversion, an over-year regulated cascade and winter-peak operation in a cold climate

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：拉格朗德複合水電系統
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: La Grande Hydroelectric Complex
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨流域引水使流量倍增」與「水頭、流量與出力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion" and "Head, discharge and output": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「跨流域引水使流量倍增」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion" is correct?
options: 水電出力與流量成正比。
水電站的發電量只取決於壩有多高。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
optionsEn: Hydropower output is proportional to flow.
The energy of a hydro station depends only on how high its dam is.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
quiz.explanation: 水電出力與流量成正比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydropower output is proportional to flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨流域引水使流量倍增：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「跨流域引水使流量倍增」如何決定「拉格朗德複合水電系統」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “La Grande Hydroelectric Complex”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 水電出力與流量成正比。拉格朗德河本身的平均流量約每秒 1,700 m³，工程以堤壩與渠道把南邊的伊斯特梅恩、奧皮納卡河與東邊的卡尼亞皮斯科河上游引過分水嶺，流量增加到約每秒 3,400 m³。引來的水流過引水點以下所有的電站，等於用同一批廠房多發一倍的電；代價是被引走的河流下游流量銳減，河口生態與居民生活都受到影響。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydropower output is proportional to flow. The La Grande itself averaged about 1,700 m³/s; dikes and channels brought the Eastmain and Opinaca from the south and the upper Caniapiscau from the east across the divides, raising flow to about 3,400 m³/s. The diverted water passes every station below the point of entry, in effect doubling the energy from the same powerhouses, at the cost of sharply reduced flow in the diverted rivers with effects on estuaries and communities. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：複合系統總裝置容量超過 16,000 MW，年發電量約 830 億 kWh
steps.observationEn: Project file: The complex exceeds 16,000 MW and generates about 83 TWh a year
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水電站的發電量只取決於壩有多高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The energy of a hydro station depends only on how high its dam is." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「跨流域引水使流量倍增」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨流域引水使流量倍增
knowledge.text: 水電出力與流量成正比。拉格朗德河本身的平均流量約每秒 1,700 m³，工程以堤壩與渠道把南邊的伊斯特梅恩、奧皮納卡河與東邊的卡尼亞皮斯科河上游引過分水嶺，流量增加到約每秒 3,400 m³。引來的水流過引水點以下所有的電站，等於用同一批廠房多發一倍的電；代價是被引走的河流下游流量銳減，河口生態與居民生活都受到影響。
knowledge.textEn: Hydropower output is proportional to flow. The La Grande itself averaged about 1,700 m³/s; dikes and channels brought the Eastmain and Opinaca from the south and the upper Caniapiscau from the east across the divides, raising flow to about 3,400 m³/s. The diverted water passes every station below the point of entry, in effect doubling the energy from the same powerhouses, at the cost of sharply reduced flow in the diverted rivers with effects on estuaries and communities.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水電站的發電量只取決於壩有多高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The energy of a hydro station depends only on how high its dam is. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 複合系統總裝置容量超過 16,000 MW，年發電量約 830 億 kWh
knowledge.textEn: The complex exceeds 16,000 MW and generates about 83 TWh a year

quiz.question: 依「跨流域引水使流量倍增」的模型 ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η，引入 1,700 m³/s 流經約 370 m 梯級總水頭所增加的平均出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η for "Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion", which value is closest to the mean output added by 1,700 m³/s of diverted flow passing about 370 m of cascade head?
quiz.explanation: ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η；代入 dQ = 1700 m³/s、H = 370 m、η = 0.9，得 5,553 MW（引入 1,700 m³/s 流經約 370 m 梯級總水頭所增加的平均出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η; with dQ = 1700 m³/s, H = 370 m, η = 0.9 the result is 5,553 MW (mean output added by 1,700 m³/s of diverted flow passing about 370 m of cascade head). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 跨流域引水使流量倍增：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨流域引水使流量倍增」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η；代入 dQ = 1700 m³/s、H = 370 m、η = 0.9，得 5,553 MW（引入 1,700 m³/s 流經約 370 m 梯級總水頭所增加的平均出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 dQ 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η; with dQ = 1700 m³/s, H = 370 m, η = 0.9 the result is 5,553 MW (mean output added by 1,700 m³/s of diverted flow passing about 370 m of cascade head). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise dQ by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：dQ 增加 10% 時，結果變為 6,109 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising dQ by 10% changes the result to 6,109 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 5,553 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 dQ 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 5,553 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in dQ with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η；代入 dQ = 1700 m³/s、H = 370 m、η = 0.9，得 5,553 MW（引入 1,700 m³/s 流經約 370 m 梯級總水頭所增加的平均出力）。
knowledge.textEn: ΔP = ρ·g·ΔQ·H·η; with dQ = 1700 m³/s, H = 370 m, η = 0.9 the result is 5,553 MW (mean output added by 1,700 m³/s of diverted flow passing about 370 m of cascade head).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: dQ 增加 10% 時，結果變為 6,109 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising dQ by 10% changes the result to 6,109 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「跨流域引水使流量倍增」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
混凝土強度越高、水泥越多，壩體就越安全。
以引水道控制結構的流量量測與各水庫的水量平衡，核對實際引水量；並在被引走河流的下游水文站追蹤流量與鹽水入侵範圍的變化。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher strength and more cement always make a dam safer.
Check actual diversion from flow measurement at the control structures and reservoir water balances, and track flow and saltwater intrusion at gauging stations downstream on the diverted rivers.
quiz.explanation: 以引水道控制結構的流量量測與各水庫的水量平衡，核對實際引水量；並在被引走河流的下游水文站追蹤流量與鹽水入侵範圍的變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check actual diversion from flow measurement at the control structures and reservoir water balances, and track flow and saltwater intrusion at gauging stations downstream on the diverted rivers. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 跨流域引水使流量倍增：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨流域引水使流量倍增」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以引水道控制結構的流量量測與各水庫的水量平衡，核對實際引水量；並在被引走河流的下游水文站追蹤流量與鹽水入侵範圍的變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual diversion from flow measurement at the control structures and reservoir water balances, and track flow and saltwater intrusion at gauging stations downstream on the diverted rivers. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：引水工程的環境承諾（最低流量、魚類監測）要有獨立的量測站與公開數據，並寫入運轉規則。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Environmental commitments of a diversion, minimum flow and fish monitoring, need independent gauging stations, published data and a place in the operating rules.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：引水控制結構在春汛時必須放棄部分引水以保護堤壩；若下游冰蓋受突然放流破壞，會形成冰壩並淹沒河岸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Diversion structures must give up part of the diversion in the spring flood to protect dikes, and sudden releases that break the downstream ice cover form ice jams and flood the banks. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以引水道控制結構的流量量測與各水庫的水量平衡，核對實際引水量；並在被引走河流的下游水文站追蹤流量與鹽水入侵範圍的變化。
knowledge.textEn: Check actual diversion from flow measurement at the control structures and reservoir water balances, and track flow and saltwater intrusion at gauging stations downstream on the diverted rivers.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 引水工程的環境承諾（最低流量、魚類監測）要有獨立的量測站與公開數據，並寫入運轉規則。
knowledge.textEn: Environmental commitments of a diversion, minimum flow and fish monitoring, need independent gauging stations, published data and a place in the operating rules.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IEC 60193 水輪機、蓄能泵與水泵水輪機模型驗收試驗。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IEC 60193 Hydraulic turbines, storage pumps and pump-turbines – Model acceptance tests. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「跨流域引水使流量倍增」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 引水控制結構在春汛時必須放棄部分引水以保護堤壩；若下游冰蓋受突然放流破壞，會形成冰壩並淹沒河岸。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
optionsEn: Diversion structures must give up part of the diversion in the spring flood to protect dikes, and sudden releases that break the downstream ice cover form ice jams and flood the banks.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
quiz.explanation: 引水控制結構在春汛時必須放棄部分引水以保護堤壩；若下游冰蓋受突然放流破壞，會形成冰壩並淹沒河岸。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Diversion structures must give up part of the diversion in the spring flood to protect dikes, and sudden releases that break the downstream ice cover form ice jams and flood the banks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 跨流域引水使流量倍增：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨流域引水使流量倍增」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Doubling flow by inter-basin diversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 引水控制結構在春汛時必須放棄部分引水以保護堤壩；若下游冰蓋受突然放流破壞，會形成冰壩並淹沒河岸。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「拉格朗德複合水電系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion structures must give up part of the diversion in the spring flood to protect dikes, and sudden releases that break the downstream ice cover form ice jams and flood the banks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “La Grande Hydroelectric Complex”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：引來的水流過引水點以下所有的電站，等於用同一批廠房多發一倍的電；代價是被引走的河流下游流量銳減，河口生態與居民生活都受到影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The diverted water passes every station below the point of entry, in effect doubling the energy from the same powerhouses, at the cost of sharply reduced flow in the diverted rivers with effects on estuaries and communities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水電站的發電量只取決於壩有多高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The energy of a hydro station depends only on how high its dam is." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 引水控制結構在春汛時必須放棄部分引水以保護堤壩；若下游冰蓋受突然放流破壞，會形成冰壩並淹沒河岸。
knowledge.textEn: Diversion structures must give up part of the diversion in the spring flood to protect dikes, and sudden releases that break the downstream ice cover form ice jams and flood the banks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 1971：詹姆斯灣開發計畫宣布
knowledge.textEn: 1971: The James Bay development was announced

quiz.question: 關於「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head, discharge and output" is correct?
options: 壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。
容量因數低就表示電廠設計失敗或機組品質不好。
水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。
optionsEn: The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be.
A low capacity factor means the plant was badly designed or the units are poor.

A hydraulic turbine converts the potential energy of water into shaft work: the water passing each second times the effective drop, less waterway, turbine and generator losses, is the electrical output.

steps.instruction: 水輪機把水的位能轉成軸功：每秒通過的水量乘上有效落差，再扣掉水道、水輪機與發電機的損失，就是電氣出力。毛水頭是上下游水位差，淨水頭還要扣除攔污柵、進水口、壓力鋼管與尾水管的水頭損失，因此同一台機組在豐水與枯水期的出力與效率並不相同。以「拉格朗德複合水電系統」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

quiz.question: 依「水頭、流量與出力」的模型 P = ρ·g·Q·H·η，額定工況的單機電氣出力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model P = ρ·g·Q·H·η for "Head, discharge and output", which value is closest to the electrical output of one unit at rated conditions?
options: 309 MW
154 MW
optionsEn: 309 MW
154 MW
quiz.explanation: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 290 m³/s、H = 116.7 m、η = 0.93，得 309 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 290 m³/s, H = 116.7 m, η = 0.93 the result is 309 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水頭、流量與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Head, discharge and output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：P = ρ·g·Q·H·η；代入 ρ = 1000、g = 9.81、Q = 290 m³/s、H = 116.7 m、η = 0.93，得 309 MW（額定工況的單機電氣出力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 H 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 290 m³/s, H = 116.7 m, η = 0.93 the result is 309 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise H by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 340 MW（+10.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 340 MW (+10.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 309 MW（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 H 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 309 MW (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in H with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: P = ρ·g·Q·H·η; with ρ = 1000, g = 9.81, Q = 290 m³/s, H = 116.7 m, η = 0.93 the result is 309 MW (electrical output of one unit at rated conditions).

knowledge.text: H 增加 10% 時，結果變為 340 MW（+10.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising H by 10% changes the result to 340 MW (+10.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水頭、流量與出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Head, discharge and output"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。
河面結冰以後，水流和電廠運轉完全不受影響。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.

Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.
Once the river surface is frozen, flow and plant operation are entirely unaffected.
quiz.explanation: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水頭、流量與出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head, discharge and output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以 IEC 60041 的現場效率試驗核對：用壓力—時間法、超音波時差法或指數法量流量，以壓力傳感器與水位計求淨水頭，以電力分析儀量發電機出力，在多個導葉開度下畫出效率曲線，與模型試驗換算值比較並標示不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：驗收文件要同時列出毛水頭、各段水頭損失與淨水頭，並註明量測斷面位置；出力保證值必須綁定淨水頭與流量，而不是水庫水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Acceptance documents should list gross head, each head-loss component and net head with the measurement sections; guaranteed output must be tied to net head and discharge, not to reservoir level.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check it with an IEC 60041 field efficiency test: measure discharge by the pressure-time, acoustic transit-time or index method, derive net head from pressure transducers and level gauges, measure generator output with a power analyser, and plot efficiency at several guide-vane openings against the scaled model-test curve with stated uncertainty.

quiz.question: 在「水頭、流量與出力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Head, discharge and output" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
容量因數低就表示電廠設計失敗或機組品質不好。
若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
A low capacity factor means the plant was badly designed or the units are poor.
Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output.
quiz.explanation: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水頭、流量與出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Head, discharge and output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水頭、流量與出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「拉格朗德複合水電系統」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height or gross head as net head overstates output; in long waterways the head loss rises with the square of discharge, so the unit cannot reach rated output at full gate and the plant appears to have enough water yet cannot deliver full load. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “La Grande Hydroelectric Complex”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以「拉格朗德複合水電系統」為例，額定水頭與額定流量是機組選型的起點，其餘尺寸、轉速與空蝕餘裕都由這兩個量推導。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: For La Grande Hydroelectric Complex, rated head and rated discharge are the starting point of unit selection; runner size, speed and cavitation margin all follow from them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩越高，每一台機組的出力就一定越大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher the dam, the larger the output of every unit must be." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 若把壩高或毛水頭直接當成淨水頭，計算出力會高於實際；長引水道在大流量時水頭損失隨流量平方上升，機組在滿載時反而達不到額定出力，營運上表現為「水夠卻發不滿」。
